=== Barley_Party 770 Objection to Applicants' Objections...Attachment A of SOAH Order No. 30 (1).pdf ===
                                   PUC DOCKET NO. 59475
                                SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-26-16349

ONCOR and LCRA TSC Bell County East to Big Hill 765 kV Transmission Project

W. TRENT & DEANNA LEA BARLEY’S (PARTY NO. 770) OBJECTION TO ONCOR
ELECTRIC DELIVERY COMPANY LLC AND LCRA TRANSMISSION SERVICES
CORPORATION'S OBJECTIONS TO CERTAIN INTERVENORS' EXHIBITS LISTED IN
ATTACHMENT A OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30

Pro se Intervenors W. Trent and Deanna Lea Barley (Party No. 770) respectfully urge the Court
to deny Applicants’ objection to Exhibit 1.

1. Applicants’ Basis for Objection of Exhibit 1: “Not in Egnyte.”
The basis for their objection is unfounded. Original upload of Exhibit 1 on egnyte: June 3,
2026, at 6:21pm.
Deanna Barley checked egnyte again on 6-7-26 at 4:10pm, and Exhibit 1 is there with the June
3, 2026, 6:21pm date/timestamp. Deanna Barley uploaded the info (Interchange Item 4475)
again on 6-7-26 at 6:56pm. (See screenshot inserted between signatures and Certificate of
Service.)

2. Applicants also objected to Exhibit 1 on the basis that, “Ex. 1 is not identified by the party in a
filed exhibit list.”
Deanna Barley uploaded an Exhibit List (for the previously timely filed Exhibit 1) on 6-7-26 at
4:16pm immediately after reading the email from Kirk Rasmussen. (See screenshot inserted
between signatures and Certificate of Service.)
As Intervenors were simply moving previously filed and accepted testimony (Item 4475) as one
item over from the Interchange, Intervenors did not realize an additional Exhibit List was
required.

3. During in the June 5, 2026, hearing, Applicants did not object to any of the exhibits pre-filed
on the Court' s SOAH Order 30 Exhibit A, subject to the opportunity to object to the late-filed
exhibits not previously included in Exhibit A or not filed in the egnyte portal. Intervenors’ Exhibit
1 was timely filed in all three portals and was included in the Court's Order; therefore,
Applicants’ objection is untimely.

4. Applicants filed their objections after the Court ordered time limit of June 7, 2026, 12 noon;
therefore, Applicants’ objections are untimely.

NOTE: Intervenors are pro se, did not submit a list of witnesses to cross-examine, and are not
on any witness list.

For the reasons stated above, Intervenors respectfully urge the Court to deny Applicants’
objection(s) to Exhibit 1.
 Respectfully submitted,

W. Trent & Deanna Barley
